Bondi's young guns race out for a number of mass rescues. And to fully initiate the new trainee in to the team, the veterans play a prank on Harrison - when they task him with counting the number of people on the beach.

Beachgoers report a drunk woman missing in the water, and the chopper is called in to search. On Australia Day, Whippet enlists honorary lifeguard Jon, a 16 year-old boy with Asperger's Syndrome. And the most critical rescue of the season stirs up emotional memories for Terry.

Big wave surfer Jesse challenges Tommy and Jules. Tommy performs two rescues of intoxicated tourists. Reidy pursues a creepy guy on the beach. There are Beard Season skin checks, and a Danish backpacker bares all on Bondi Beach.
Kite surfers make the most of the wild conditions when the biggest storm of the season hits Bondi. Chappo and Jack race to help a man with agonising chest pains, and Harries confronts a body surfer.

On the hottest day ever in Bondi, tempers flare in the heat and a fight erupts on the beach. A blistering Northwest wind sweeps a couple and their boogie board half a kilometre out to sea. Terry encounters a man in excruciating pain after losing his boardies.

A surfing collision results in a deep water spinal rescue. Mouse, AKA 'The Black Cloud' lives up to his nick name when he rescues a man with no pants, gets kicked in the face, and is then vomited on. And lifeguards try catch a rat that's been eating through the electrical cables on their buggies.

A dedicated mother disappears from suburban Los Angeles, leaving behind three kids and a husband she planned to divorce. Law enforcement quickly determines she's been the victim of a homicide but it takes them nearly two decades to unravel the mystery, and bring her killer to justice.

Dr. Kim comes back unexpectedly, as they all thought he was still under investigation. Everyone doesn't also expect Dr. Kim's new visitor, who happens to be Chairman Shin himself. After being mocked by Hyeon Cheol for being incompetent, Dr. Kim now operates on the big boss. After Dong Joo speaks up of the truth of the unjust treatment received by Doldam Hospital, the chairman makes an important phone call.

Dong Joo tells Seo Jung to never leave without telling him again. Their conversation is interrupted by the 6-car accident on the road ahead of them. At the hospital, Eun Tak punches an investigator that prompts the need for police intervention. The problem faced by Dr. Kim now is the fact that the whole place is a mess, and there's chaos coming for them.

Seo Jung is caught inside Dr. Kim's office, while President Do convinces Dong Joo to be part of his team. Yoon Wan wants to test the worth of Dong Joo, while Dr. Kim worries that Seo Jung isn't trustworthy enough just yet. Dong Joo now deals with a patient who is suspected of being abused. The drunk driver from the major accident shows up with his rich mother that ultimately bothers Seo Jung.

An advanced death certificate needs to be signed by Dong Joo. He refuses to do so, but President Do and Hyeon Cheol urge him to act quickly against his will. Dr. Kim comes into the office just in time to witness the act. A cardiac arrest happens in the emergency ward, which prompts Dong Joo and Seo Jung to team up against the call of death. Another day in Doldam is another day of broken and mended hearts.

In Bum reveals the condition of Chairman Shin to Dr. Kim. His heart condition doesn't seem great, and he wants to assist in the operation. What appears to be a mere urge to take action is unknowingly a plot assembled by the president to keep an eye on Dr. Kim during his alleged unethical practice. An eager Seo Jung catches up on her mentor and gathers information to solve the medical case.

Dong Joo succumbs to the fatigue, and he ends up contracting the MERS virus. Although Dr. Kim wants to take over, Seo Jung stops him from risking his life for it. She enters and handles the deadly contagious patient. Now that she puts herself on the line, she also crosses herself out of the list of people allowed to operate on Chairman Shin the task she's worked hard on for the past weeks.

Gi Joon proposes to Chae Yeon, but she gets angry at his attitude. Ri Jin agrees to be Do Hyun's secret doctor, but is shocked to learn she has to live in the same house as him. Thus begins their uneasy and awkward cohabitation.

Ri Jin encounters all of Do Hyun's personalities in one night — except for Shin Se Gi. Gi Joon and Chae Yeon are stunned when Ri Jin shows up at the company as Do Hyun's secretary, while Ri On meets Do Hyun under his secret identity as Writer Omega.

Se Gi declares all-out war against Do Hyun, and Ri Jin is taken aback by his icy demeanor. Chae Yeon is startled when Se Gi suddenly appears before her. When Se Gi arrives at the company, all eyes turn to him, and he even confronts Gi Joon directly. Meanwhile, Hwa Ran meets Ri Jin and tells her to report everything Do Hyun does.

Tae Im faints in shock after seeing Se Gi on the hospital CCTV in Cha Jun Pyo's room. Ri Jin decides to leave home, and Ri On reluctantly lets her go. Meanwhile, Se Gi demands that Ri Jin choose between him and Do Hyun, but Ri Jin retorts, “Then show me what makes you special.”

Do Hyun despairs after realizing the things Se Gi has done. Chae Yeon grows even more conflicted over Do Hyun's sudden change in attitude. Ri Jin, like Se Gi once did, struggles to help Do Hyun change for the better, while Tae Im meets Seok Ho Pil.

Ri Jin begins having nightmares, worrying Do Hyun. However, she keeps her distance, prompting Do Hyun to reconsider her relationship with Ri On. Meanwhile, Young Pyo becomes convinced that Min Seo Yeon's child is still alive, and Ri On has his first encounter with Yo Na, one of Do Hyun's personalities.
Jini falls under the stairs and loses her baby. Feeling guilty, Kim Jeonghan disappears.
Jini dances the same dance again in the market, but is flustered when she is completely ignored.

During the competition for the Bunwon nangcheong position, Gangcheon comes face to face with Euldam and is unable to contain his anger. Meanwhile, Royal Noble Consort Inbin, the King's favored consort, devises a scheme in preparation for any possible outcome. At last, King Seonjo examines the porcelain made by Euldam and Gangcheon and reaches a careful decision. After meeting with Gangcheon, Yeonok is seized by severe labor pains…

Leaving the collapsed Gwanghae behind, Jeongi escapes home with Taedo's help. While hiding at a tavern, Jeongi overhears a conversation between King Seonjo and Euldam, only to be startled when her eyes meet Gwanghae's. King Seonjo orders Euldam to create ritual vessels to be used for the Jongmyo ancestral rites.

Tormented by the shattered fragments of the sacred jar of King Taejo, Gwanghae seeks out Son Haengsu. Recognizing him, Hwa-ryeong urges Gwanghae to meet Jeongi, and he is stunned to learn that she is Euldam's daughter. When Jeongi falls from her horse and lands in Gwanghae's arms, she panics and struggles in surprise—only for them both to tumble to the ground.

Determined to prove that the sacred jar of King Taejo was deliberately broken, Gangcheon drops the vessel onto the floor. As King Seonjo erupts in fury, Gwanghae steps forward and claims full responsibility for the act. King Seonjo immediately orders Euldam's arrest. In a desperate attempt to save her father, Jeongi strikes the petition drum, proclaiming Euldam's innocence to the court…

Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

In order to reach the Emperor of the Eastern Caverns, Eli and Junjie pose as Underlords to enter the Tournament of Underlords.

While Junjie struggles with the knowledge of what he did during his time as the Dark Slinger, the Shane Gang meet a former servant of the Emperor who wants to turn over a new leaf. But can the Shane Gang help a bad guy learn to do good?

When the Shane Gang arrive at a cavern overrun by thieves terrorizing the good townfolk, they decide to use Pronto as bait, hoping the thieves will eliminate each other as each strives to be the first to capture the valuable molenoid-the only one the Eastern Caverns have ever seen. However, their plan goes awry when Underlord Holt arrives and commands the thieves to work together to bring him Pronto-dead or alive!

When a human designer realeases a new fragrance, the monsters discover it works as a toxic gas against them.  Oblina's not superstitious, but when she  steps on a slug her luck changes.
When the viewfinder stops working, Ickism Oblina and Krumm tell very different versions of the same scare.  Ickis eats a seed that grew on a tree, and soon finds he's turning into a tree himself.

Doug and Skeeter decide to work together to create their own comic book. Roger and his pet Stinky challenge Doug and Porkchop to enter the Bluffington pet talent show.

Through an error in the guidance counselor's computer, Doug is chosen corporate executive in charge of the class project for Career Week. Defending himself, Doug punches Larry the AV nerd, who thought Doug was making fun of him.

programmes.st: Doug's Huge Zit/Doug Flies A Kite

To celebrate Boris and Minka's anniversary, the whole gang takes a train trip to Little Biendeltown, a theme park recreation of the Old Country. The scenic 18-hour journey is a send-up of Agatha Christie-style mysteries.

When Didi decides to go "back to school", Angelica explains that soon Tommy will be a baby like Dil again./ Chas and Kira pursue their dream of owning a coffee shop while the Rugrats pursue their own dream - or, rather, Chuckie's dream.

When the Thornberrys visit Nigel's friend Jomo, they search for an elephant, Rebecca, that Nigel saved twenty years ago. As the family attends to an elephant stuck in a mudhole, Eliza bonds with Rebecca.
When Eliza accidentally reads Debbie's diary she learns that Debbie thinks she's an embarrassment of a sister. Debbie and Eliza have it out and learn the real truth about their sistership.

When Eliza tries to swim with the humpback whales, Darwin's clumsiness leads to an accident that causes the whales to stop their ritual singing. When Eliza tries to set things right, she is arrested for violating the Marine Mammal Protection Act.

Eliza and her father travel to a cove to film a rare fish,  but Eliza is frightened by strange voices coming from a bog and convinces her father to take a different route. But when Nigel is stung by a deadly fish, Eliza must go back through the bog.

When Eliza meets a group of temple monkeys, they con her into bringing all of her family's food. While Darwin tries to convince her otherwise, Eliza realizes that she's been duped and learns the value of Darwin's friendship.
The Thornberrys are invited on a cattle drive by Marianne's old high school friend. Though he talks a big talk, their son, Miguel, is not as adept at riding and roping as he claims.
When it's time for Helga to step down as Hall Monitor, Helga chooses Phoebe as her replacement. Helga assumes that Phoebe will let Helga maintain the extra perks which come with the assignment.
Arnold and Gerald are so desperate to bowl in an upcoming tournament, they recruit their old basketball coach, Coach Wittenberg, to be their bowling coach.
Tour de Pond/Teacher's Strike: After happening upon a snotty rich kid named, Rex, who is legendary for winning the annual toy boat race, Arnold and Gerald decide to enter the race.

Arnold's Valentine: It's Valentine's Day at school and Arnold and his friends are exchanging Valentine's cards.  Arnold anonymously invites sixth grade Ruth to dinner, not really expecting her to show up.
For their science fair project, Arnold and Gerald planned to lock themselves in Grandpa's dilapidated greenhouse in the backyard for twenty-four hours.

Arnold and Helga are editors of competing school newspapers. Harold softens when he finds a lost cat and then refuses to give it up to its rightful owner. Arnold eventually persuades Harold to give up the kitty.
After Arnold saves Sid from injury, Sid devotes himself to paying Arnold back with unending kindness. Arnold and Gerald play hookey, but intense paranoia thwarts their day.

The babies are worried that their new babysitter, a teen-angst wannabe rocker named Taffy, is unhappy because she sings such sad songs./Angelica coerces the Rugrats to take roles in her make-believe game based on her favorite TV show, "The Cynthia Team".
The entire gang heads to Club Fred for some rest and relaxation. Once in paradise, the babies must find Bluebeard's treasure to save the holiday for everyone.

Wealthy Logan is in for a serious change in lifestyle when his outrageous spending prompts his dad to cut him off. Meanwhile, Michael says he can get out of any difficultly tied ropes, so Mark and Quinn tie him up to see what he can do.
The Rats and their mothers embark on a cross country trip in a beat up R.V. to bring Susie to New York, where she's been selected to perform in a Thanksgiving parade.
Tired of being considered a goody two shoes by the popular kids, Susie tries desperately to prove that she can be a bad girl. Meanwhile, Phil discovers that he has a talent for cooking.

When Tommy forgoes the traditional opening day ball game outing with his Grandpa, Lou takes Dil instead. This makes Tommy jealous as he and Dil compete to be Grandpa's favorite grandson during a fishing trip.
When Chuckie discovers that Kimi is upset, he gets the gang to help him redesign her room. It turns out that she is homesick for Japan and misses her biological father.
When the gang looks for Halloween costumes in the Finster's basement, they find TP+KF carved on the wall. Chuckie is furious that Tommy might like Kimi and their friendship is put to the test.
When the comic book starring Chuckie's favorite superhero gets canceled, he is too depressed to help Tommy with his science fair project. The gang tries to find Chuckie a new hero to worship.

programmes.st: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programmes.d: Angelica falls in love with a handsome sub teacher. She tries to date him by failing her assignments. Meanwhile, Tommy, Phil, and Chuckie are part of the tennis club run by Pangborn and Chuckie is afraid to shower in the locker room.

Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

Big Time Bonus: Gustavo gives the guys a bonus for their hard work, but they quickly begin to make bad decisions with their money.

BTR is making a cameo on a popular kid’s TV show, but Carlos’ pursuit of the show’s teen star puts him and Kendall in the crosshairs of her evil stage mother. Logan & James battle Yo Gabba Gabba over their amazing snack table.
It’s time again for the prank war at the Palm Woods, and this time it's kids versus adults as they battle for the honor of winning Lord Prankington’s Cup.

James continues his pursuit of Lucy and buys a motorcycle in order to impress her, but he doesn’t know how to drive it. Kendall teaches Jo how to drive stick-shift, and Carlos & Logan can’t relinquish a childhood treasure.
Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm, but when Carlos somehow gets a higher score, Logan questions his plans to become a doctor.

When Drake and Josh decide to turn the tables and prank little Megan, she has the whole family believing that aliens are coming.
In our season finale, Drake and Josh go on the Dr. Phyliss Show and relive some of their most outlandish moments. Some will jab at your funny bone, while others will tug on your heart strings.
With their parents out of town and Megan planning a trip to Denver, Drake and Josh find they'll have the house to themselves for the week.
Ryan overhears Amanda's boyfriend making other plans for lunch so he, Lulu, and True decide to follow him only to discover he's cheating on her.
True tries to fix Max up with the librarian from school.  Meanwhile, Amanda and Oscar bond over their secret love of a ridiculous soap opera.
Amanda undergoes all sorts of beauty treatments in preparation for her High School reunion. Meanwhile, True, Ryan and Lulu come across Amanda's old yearbook and discover she was a nerd.
Lulu needs a dress for Handsome Academy's summer dance. True decides to lend Lulu a dress from the famous Mad Style dress vault, unaware that it is a one-of-a-kind prototype.
Kel takes on a job at a donut shop.  It's not long before he's created a sensational new donut and not long after that, he ruins the store.
Kenan and Kel take a trip to the mall and manage to get themselves locked out of their dressing rooms.  One minor problem, Kenan is dressed only in his underwear and a tee-shirt.

Kenan and Kel adopt a chimpanzee through the zoo's adopt-a-critter program.  After the guys are informed that their pet is being transferred, Kel decides that he's going to kidnap the monkey. Too bad he loses the monkey shortly thereafter.

The guys are pitched a kids cartoon show but instead do a video game to expand their brand. A mix-up while wearing motion capture suits puts them at the center of an extraterrestrial news story.
After being told that boy bands always split up after the third album, the guys compete to find solo “breakout” gigs before being left behind.

BTR is on tour with Victoria Justice and we go inside the guys’ bus to see the craziness that happens on board. When the guys get stuck in traffic, it is up to Victoria to keep the concert audience entertained until they arrive.

Big Time Dreams Pt. 1: It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show!  However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.
After Drake forgets Josh's birthday he tries to make it up to him by taking him to a live taping of "Oprah".    Things, however, take a turn when they run into an unexpected guest.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram, Day 5

programmes.st: Anita Manning and James Lewis, Day 2

programmes.st: Anita Manning and James Lewis, Day 3

programmes.st: Anita Manning and James Lewis, Day 4
programmes.d: Anita Manning and James Lewis wind through Devon, beginning in Exeter and traveling though Crediton and Torquay, headed for auction in Chudleigh.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and James Lewis, Day 5
programmes.d: On their last leg, Anita Manning and James Lewis begin in Dorchester, then travel to Portsmouth and Fareham before their final auction in London.

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Will Axon, Day 1

In an interrogation room, Twenty Faces reveals what made him decide to operate outside the law to punish criminals.

Akechi's chaotic day starts when Kobayashi finds an abandoned kitten at the front door of the Akechi Detective Agency; Kobayashi wants to keep the kitten, but Akechi does not approve, and then another incident occurs.

In the midst of experiencing pregnancy hormones, Linda decides to tell Phillip about the baby.

In a sudden change of heart, Philip has decided he wants to marry Linda; he tells Danny and Hattie.
Linda can't handle the morning sickness any longer.
Philip panics when the engagement ring is missing; Floyd, Sam and Danny try to help him find it.
Philip doubts himself; Hattie convinces him to start over and give Linda the ring.
Hattie throws a surprise party for Linda to make her feel more appreciated by everyone.
Linda's son Danny tries to plan his mom a surprise baby shower, but Philip has other plans to surprise Linda and asks her to marry him by singing and playing the piano.
Linda ask Ella Payne to help plan her wedding. Meanwhile, Curtis wants Floyd to pay him back for his investment in the diner.
Drew reveals her love for Danny.
Linda has to tell P.J. and Caroline that she's engaged to their father.
Linda meets Philip's ex in-laws; her family comes along.
Hattie prepares for spring cleaning at the diner; Linda explains why she can't move in with Phillip.
Linda threatens to call the wedding off if Philip does not change the furniture in his house.
Philip allows Linda to redecorate the house in whatever way she chooses.
After Hattie finds out that Danny got a promotion, she asks him to help pay for Linda's wedding.
Linda asks Hattie if she'll stay and help her when the baby comes, because she doubts that Philip will help with the newborn.

Troy and Danny inevitably do something stupid in Las Vegas. In the last minute, Linda's water breaks while she is 6 months pregnant.

Suzanne suspects that Nick may have fathered his ex-flame's son. Ice Cube and Kandi Burruss guest star.

Suzanne and Marilyn convene for a spa weekend for Mother's Day, but friction soon mounts between the two.
Lindsey decides to take on a vegan diet and lifestyle, but she may have ulterior motives in doing so.
Nick tries to give his family the best vacation ever but things do not go well at all.

After Ryan's meltdown, Kat and Van confront him about his erratic behavior. When the crew questions Kat's loyalty to the shop after she plans to attend a tattoo convention in New York without her 9Mag family, tensions escalate. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: You're Not God And You're Not My Daddy
programmes.d: The rest of the 9Mag crew heads to New York City to lend support to Kat and get in some partying while they're there. Ceaser and the NY crew throw a mixxxy party in their honor, but things get ugly when Charmaine taunts Don. Presented by VH1.

What happens in New York, stays in New York...not! Upon their return from the Big Apple, Charmaine reveals a secret about her and Don's relationship. Phor receives some shocking news about his biological father. Presented by VH1.

Ryan decides to throw a shop appreciation party in true Chicago summer fashion...on a yacht! While Kat takes some time away from the shop to think things through, the rest of the 9Mag crew lets loose. Presented by VH1.

Shocking news at Van's final court appearance leaves him wondering if he should run. Kat's enjoying her time away from 9 Mag, but when the girls fail to pay her a visit, she questions their loyalty. Presented by VH1.

With the death toll in Chicago at an all-time high, the 9Mag crew hosts an event to help victims of violent crimes. Meanwhile, in the Dominican Republic, Don tries to win Ashley back. Presented by VH1.

When the woman who brought Ceaser up in the tattoo world visits the shop for a memorial tattoo from Cease, she has some strong opinions about his relationship with Dutchess. Alex and Dutchess finally meet face to face. Presented by VH1.

The Black Ink Crew is back! Ceaser & Puma's friendship comes to an end when Puma oversteps his boundaries. Dutchess and Ceaser question whether their relationship is strong enough to withstand the stress of Black Ink's newfound success. Presented by VH1.

When the electric company arrives and pulls the power because Cease hasn't paid the bill, the crew can't work and they are forced to close the shop. Recording artist Erica Mena stops by the shop to have Dutchess cover a tattoo. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew No Structure to the Madness
programmes.d: In the wake of Sassy's dramatic departure, Ceaser is left to wonder if the joke, and Dutchess' attitude, have gone too far.  Alex uncovers some scandalous information about Dutchess online…information that could ruin her reputation.  Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew These are Minions!
programmes.d: With the Black Ink staff dwindling, Ceaser meets with a potential new (female) employee, who is quickly shot down by Dutchess.  Puma checks in with Alex and gives her some news that could lead to civil war within the Black Ink Crew. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew The Year of the Puma
programmes.d: When Dutchess tells Ceaser the news about Puma's new tattoo shop, he is shocked and hurt by his friend's betrayal.  Ceaser tattoos Jadakiss, who gets him thinking about friendship and loyalty. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew You're a Wreck!
programmes.d: AIDS activist Maria Davis visits Dutchess at the shop for an HIV/AIDS Awareness tattoo and the entire crew is moved by her inner strength and personal story. After arriving over 4 hours late, Alex makes a dramatic exit from a photo shoot. Presented by VH1

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew I Did Not Sleep With That Women!
programmes.d: When Dutchess and Ceaser are hours late for a photo shoot at the shop, the editor of the magazine rips them a new one. When Ceaser confronts Walt about his drinking, Walt reveals some shocking news that will change his future. Presented by VH1.

O'S**t reaches new "baby mama" heights when he reveals that he has yet another child on the way. Dutchess shows up at a meeting and sees an ex-boyfriend. When Ceaser finds out, he loses his cool and deserts her at his family BBQ. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Have Several Seats
programmes.d: In the wake of Dutchess and Ceaser's fight, Ceaser is left confused about their future together and escapes to Puma's bachelor party in Atlantic City. Kathy comes for a tattoo from O'S**t, to get some closure and move on with her life. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew You Got Some Stupid Ears
programmes.d: Puma decides to invite Ceaser to his wedding on the condition that he leaves Dutchess at home. Walt's frustrating search comes to an end when a letter arrives at the shop with information about his father. Presented by VH1.

When an officer is accused of using excessive force on a suspect, Frank finds his department under scrutiny from the community and the mayor.

Following Frank’s dinner with mob lawyer Angelo Gallo, Gallo is shot, and Frank narrowly escapes with his own life. Meanwhile, Danny is called for jury duty and winds up being the sole dissenting opinion in a murder trial.
Danny and Baez investigate a homicide in which Baez’s estranged brother, a former drug addict, is the lead suspect.
Danny and Baez investigate a local bombing but meet with tension and resistance from the community during the investigation.
Danny’s loyalty is tested when he is assigned to the case of a childhood friend, Mickey, who is under investigation for having ties to an infamous mob family.

When Danny learns from Nicky that there’s a deadly new brand of heroin hitting the streets, he begins an all-out manhunt for the distributor. Meanwhile, Frank pulls out all the stops to assist in getting the drugs off the street.

Danny and Baez must track down a Marine veteran who Danny thinks is suffering from PTSD. Meanwhile, Frank is caught off-guard during a press conference by a woman who is seeking justice for her murdered daughter.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of Tiffany Lamp, a popular drag queen from a reality television show who was found murdered in a local park.
When Danny and Baez investigate the kidnapping of a young girl who disappeared after school, it brings back difficult memories for Danny, who worked on a similar unsolved case many years ago.
When Danny takes a call from a woman who is threatening to kill herself along with the man who killed her parents in a drunk driving accident, he rushes to find her.

Danny and Baez investigate when an expectant mother is a victim of a 'knockout game,' in which teenagers punch unsuspecting civilians in the head. Meanwhile, Frank wrestles with promoting an officer when he thinks it can be viewed as favoritism.

Danny and Baez investigate the death of a woman whose body was dumped after she was killed by a lethal dose of lidocaine following secret plastic surgery. Meanwhile, Frank privately assigns Jamie a cold case and Erin tries out speed dating.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of a respected college professor who was involved with a questionable scholarship program.

When Erin is assigned to investigate a case in which an on-duty police officer is accused of killing a suspect already in custody, Frank urges her to stick to the facts to avoid a publicity scandal for the NYPD.
When a detective from Danny’s precinct is killed while working undercover, Frank puts on a full-court press to find his killer, only to discover that the deceased had a big secret.
When Danny is placed on modified duty after investigating a case that was off-limits, he realizes he stumbled upon something that someone is trying to keep quiet.
As Danny and Baez escort confiscated drugs to a remote location for incineration, their convoy is attacked and Baez is seriously injured, leaving Danny to track down the drug cartel responsible.
A peaceful Indian is framed for the kidnapping of a young girl, a stunt which ends of tragedy.
The mother of a young outlaw condemned to hang, threatens to have her gang's hostages killed if her son is not set free.  One of the hostages is Joe.

Hoss chooses a difficult path when he decides to rehabilitate a famous poet, Will Smith, who is really William Warlock Evans, who spends too much time drinking and eventually his wife arrives at the Ponderosa.
Adam, Hoss, and Joe vie for the attention of a pretty young lady named Dolores.  Hoss talks Joe into entering a bull fight, but it doesn't work out quite as planned.
Hoss is suffering from spring fever, goes to the wrong town and is accused of bank robbery.

Little Joe convinces Ben to hire Harry Starr, a half-Indian who is accused by other ranchers of being a chronic horse thief. Joe sets out to prove the others wrong, but is the youngest Cartwright's trust misplaced?
An author is inspired to write about the heroic Cartwrights after watching first-hand as they fight off an attempted robbery of a stage.
Hoss decides to help out Wade Tyree and introduces him to Abigail and her daughter, Bonnie.  Hoss hopes this will stop Wade's constant drinking.
Ben's plans to marry Katherine Saunders are upset when her son Eden is accused of killing his former girlfriend.
Ben is attracted to Sarah Reynolds, a member of a religious order led by her fanatical uncle.  When she is accused of being a witch, the Cartwrights step in.
Lafe Jessup doesn't really want to be married, and now he's about to be a father!  The horse wrangler finds a fight with Hoss at his reluctance to perform his duties.

Sam Logan is released from jail after serving his twenty year sentence for stealing $100,000 worth of gold dust.  He is followed by a bounty hunter who believes Sam will lead him to where the gold is buried.
The Cartwrights play host to Guido Borelli, a world renowed aerial acrobat who once saved Ben's life in Italy.  Borelli's troup is beset by internal strife, and is performing in Virginia City.
After their stagecoach crashes, a group of rag-tag passengers and Joe must get out of the desert alive.  One of the passengers may or may not be a murderer and Joe is accused.
Hoss finds a kindred spirit in Skeeter Dexter, a lonesome young man who feels closer to animals than most people.
Two Virginia City old-timers fool Hoss and Joe into raising rabbits, and the Ponderosa is overrun with paws and whiskers.
Ben and Claire Armory fall in love, but their future is jeopardized by her disabled brother.

Grissom and Sara investigate the murder of a mental-hospital patient and quickly narrow down the suspects to a handful of other patients and staff members.
A man (Alan Rosenberg) whom Catherine flirted with at a bar reappears in her life as a suspect in a murder investigation of a woman who was shot and killed.
Two amorous freshmen are found dead in a sleeping bag in a dorm room, and Sara and Greg run into one dead end after another as they try to determine why the students were killed.
The CSI teams come together to save one of their own when they learn one team member has been kidnapped and buried alive, and now they must find him before he suffocates under 5 feet of dirt.
Two couples meet in a bar and one of the couples is murdered. When a second couple is murdered in a similar fashion the team suspects a pair of serial killers are on the loose.
When the lead suspects in Grissom's serial killer case are murdered, Grissom suspects an inside job.
Grissom and Warrick get the case of an elderly woman found mummified in her closet. Sara and Nick arrive to investigate a breaking and entering to find a raped teen.
During the latest heatwave in Las Vegas, with triple-digit temperatures, Gil and Catherine investigate a baby locked in a car.
The team is introduced to the Furry side of Vegas when a man is found dead on the side of the road, dressed in a raccoon suit.
A severed head is shipped to Dr. Robbins from Jackpot, Nevada. Grissom goes to Jackpot to find the rest of the body and gets very little cooperation from the locals.
Warrick's appearance at the preliminary hearing on a rape and murder case goes terribly wrong when the only piece of evidence is thrown out on a technicality.
A suspect's infatuation with Catherine results in her taking over a high-profile case.
The sheriff is under political pressure to find who killed an air marshal with a car bomb that the sheriff witnessed.
A teenager is found murdered on a construction site. Grissom, Sara, and Warrick follow the lead of blood on a hammer.
The lone holdout on a jury is found dead in the jury room. The eleven jurors who were voting guilty and who hated the dead juror are the natural suspects.
A woman found murdered in her home. Her resemblance to Sara causes Grissom to take a personal interest in the case and forces him to examine the decisions he has made in his life.
When an unidentified girl is found dead near a very strict rehabilitation camp, Horatio and the team investigate her murder.
Horatio and the team are called to investigate when a prostitute is found stabbed to death and stuffed under a bed after the body was cleaned.
When it's revealed that a ring of underground labs are manufacturing deadly drugs, Horatio and Speedle investigate the situation.
Horatio and Speedle investigate when a burglar and rapist has been sexually assaulted and taped to his bedposts after being suffocated to death.
Horatio and the team are exposed to radiation while investigating a murder, which leads them to an environmental lawyer dying of radiation poisoning.
Horatio and the team are called to investigate the murder of an eastern European immigrant stabbed to death in a peep show booth.
Horatio and his team race to find new evidence for a murder trial already underway in order to avoid the conviction of a possibly innocent man.
It was supposed to be a routine undercover trip to the incinerator to dispose of drug evidence, but the police officers are ambushed.
Horatio's case of a murdered woman is compromised when the federal agents, who have their own agenda to follow, get involved.
An ex-con who Horatio sent to jail asks him to help find his missing son. He finds marijuana while searching the boy’s room.
Students from all over the country descend on Miami for a week of fun in the sun. The party comes to a halt when the CSIs are called in on two cases.
Speedle and Delko are enjoying a hot Miami nightspot, "Club Descent," when the DJ's pyrotechnics triggers a fire that engulfs the club.
The CSIs delve into the "tweaker" culture after a brutal murder and near-fatal explosion takes place at the home of a methamphetamine addict.
When Horatio is called to the Miami West Detention Center to investigate a murdered inmate, he ends up witnessing three inmates escape.
After a young model is killed by a hit and run driver, Horatio investigates the car's owner, who claims he loaned it out to the guests at his party.
A man harpooned to his yacht leads Horatio into the world of modern-day treasure hunting and the massive greed that goes along with it.
Tennis phenom Lana Walker is taken from her bedroom in the night and the only evidence they have to go on is a purple fiber found in the window frame.
Mac informs an ex-con that he served time for a crime he didn't commit, and Anna tells Danny it's time for the first CSI baby to be born.
Stella discovers that New Yorkers are being murdered over ancient Greek artifacts, she hands over her badge to follow a clue that leads to Greece.
When transferring Robert Dunbrook's son from prison to court, the NYPD is ambushed by a group of professional kidnappers.
One CSI New York team member's life is changed forever in a significant way following the aftermath of a shooting incident.
The CSI New York team is tracking a cyber-killer who is currently threatening the lives of several medical healthcare workers.
This week the CSI New York team is hunting for a serial killer who is equipped with an incredibly deadly sense of direction.
The CSI New York team of investigators discovers DNA that contradicts a murder case that was seemingly open and shut before.
The CSI New York team of investigators is called in to investigate the very recent murder of an underground hip-hop dancer.
While investigating the murder of a software executive, the CSIs are exposed to the underground world of food splooshing.
Las Vegas CSI Ray Langston comes to New York to help Mac and the CSI team try and save a hostage from a human trafficking ring.
The CSI New York team of investigators resumes their hunt for the Compass Killer after a body falls from the 59th street bridge.
In the culmination of a multi-episode mystery, the CSI New York team of investigators uncovers the dark lair of the Compass Killer.
The CSI New York team follows up on a 911 call to a vacant penthouse but finds a nearly 100-Year-Old corpse and a booby-trapped house.
A reformed drug addict is found dead in an alley and the CSI New York team discovers he was the victim of a premeditated plot.
When the CSIs investigate a brutal stabbing, they discover that evidence at the crime scene was planted which pits them against a trusted colleague.
When a beautiful star quarterback of the lingerie league is found murdered in a hot tub, the CSIs are called in to find out who wanted her dead.
When a young woman is found dead in Central Park the CSI New York team is lured into the mysterious subculture of vampirism.

Dora and Boots are heading to the Bike Shop to pick up Boots' very first bike today.
Dora's helping her new friend, Pepe the Pig, learn all about his new school. Pepe's really excited, especially when he hears that if the class earns 3 gold stars today, they get a popcorn party!

programmes.st: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part I:  Tale of the Unicorn King
programmes.d: Unicornio has been chosen King of Enchanted Forest, but he needs help from Dora, Boots, and YOU to discover that he's kind, smart, brave and strong enough for the job!
Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

Dora and Boots are reading stories about knights when suddenly they hear a cry for help. It's a princess who's calling to us from the Royal Garden! It turns out that it's not the princess that needs saving—her kitty's stuck in a tree!

Swiper was packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his grandma's house. But just as he was about to go, a big wind came in and blew everything away! Will Swiper find a way to use his new super-Swiper-spin today?!

programmes.st: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Parts 2 and 3: Dora Saves King Unicornio
programmes.d: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves, and fairies from the forest! But the Enchanted Forest is for everyone!
Dora and Boots are waiting for a visit from the Hip-Hop-Bunny, who's bringing all the Easter Eggs for the big Egg Hunt! But when Swiper swipes the hip-hop bunny's basket,
When the train to the Big Horse Show breaks down, Dora, Boots, and Pinto the Pony need your help to get there with the ribbons, so Pinto can win his first blue prize ribbon!
Dora and Boots are getting ready for a big beach picnic with their friends, but when Benny gets stranded on Coconut Island, he'll need rescuing from Dora, Boots and YOU!

Join Dora for a Father's Day adventure! When the Little Kite she makes for Papi gets blown away in the wind, she'll need your help taking a hovercraft and a go-cart to catch Little Kite before she goes out over the ocean!

Dora gets to start the Big Gymnastics Show! But when Swiper swipes her special rainbow ribbon, Dora and Boots need your help on a gymnastics-filled adventure to get it back so they can begin the show! Fantastic gymnastics!
One night, while taking care of Abuela's 3 kitties, Dora awakens to find that Lucky has chased a ball of string right into a storybook world! Help her find him on a magical moonlight adventure!

Dora has a big surprise for Perrito on Surprise Hill, but Swiper's trying to get there first to swipe it! Join Dora, Boots, and Perrito for an animal-filled adventure with help from lots of friends and their playful pets too!
Everyone's getting ready for the big Thanksgiving Day parade and dinner, but the Pirate Piggies accidentally float away on Dora's boat float.

Dora's on her way to the doctor's for her yearly check up!  Dora likes going to see Dr. Valds because she gets to hear her heartbeat, see how much she's grown in one year and get a new sticker at the end of the visit!

Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!
Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.
Dora and Isa have been learning how the Earth's natural energy can power things we use every day. So they've made a volcano for the Science Fair!
Dora and Boots are at the beach when they find finda little lost mermaid who needs to get back to her mommy at Mermaid Cove. Together the 3 set off on an underwater adventure!
Dora and Boots discover Pincel, a cute little paintbrush who's lost and really wants to get back to Painter Daniella at the Art Studio.
Today's Benny's Sing-Along Party is where Dora and Benny are going to sing a very special song together! C'mon, let's all sing-along!
Dora and Boots take a rainbow butterfly, a mariposa, to the Butterfly Ball, where everybody gets to have wings.

programmes.st: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure

Dora and Boots become book explorers and enter the worlds of Peter Pan, the Wizard of Oz, and Little Red Riding Hood so they can find missing objects for the library's Story Wall.
While Dora's kitties run through a magic mirror, Dora becomes Dora in Wonderland! Join her and Boots on a double-length adventure through the magical, mixed-up world of Wonderland!
Dora travels to Brazil to play in the Big Cup soccer tournament, and if her team can beat the Monsters, they'll win the Big Cup.
Dora, Boots, Benny, and a stroller full of rambunctious puppies rush to save their puppy friend, Little Boots, before he wakes up a bear.

Dora and Boots are making a shape train in his Boots' sticker book, but when the train goes rolling down the track without Círculo, the steering wheel, they need your help to catch it before it gets to Big Turn!
Dora, Boots, and Verde the clean-up truck need your help on an adventure to clear up a flood at Party Park in time for Verde's birthday party! ¡Vámonos!

Dora, Boots, and Abuela are exploring the rainforest looking for the secret door to Adventure Forest! It's a magical forest amusement park that Abuela used to go to when she was a little girl!

Krystle loses her baby; Steven and Sammy Jo begin dating, although Steven is in love with Claudia. Fallon continues her affair with Nick, and is jealous to find him visiting Krystle in the hospital.

Fallon learns she is pregnant and tells Jeff she is having an abortion; he agrees to divorce her but only if she bears the child. Krystle remains despondent over the loss of her baby; Claudia takes a job with Denver-Carrington.

Alexis tricks Blake into coming to Rome and further traps him by hiring a gossip photographer to snap suggestive photos of the two; Jeff begs Fallon to cancel her abortion; as Nick confronts Krystle, his consolation gives way to passion.

Fallon confesses her love to Nick, but he is interested in Krystle; Blake's attempts to bring gangster Logan Rhinewood before a Crime Committee hearing are thwarted; Sammy Jo tells Alexis she knows her secret; Blake receives an anonymous letter.
Krystle says goodbye to Nick and leaves Denver; Blake offers to adopt Jeff; Cecil blackmails Claudia; Nick accepts Blake's explanation of his brother's death.

At a party in her honor, Sammy Jo embarrasses the Carringtons and reveals to Fallon that Blake is not her father; Jeff leaves the party with Claudia; Blake tells Krystle his eyesight is restored; Fallon is left unconscious after a car accident.

Fallon gives birth to a son; Alexis offers Sammy Jo $25,000 to leave Denver; Jeff and Claudia make love; Krystle accuses Alexis of killing her baby; Alexis learns Krystle and Blake are not legally married.

Upon learning he is not her true father, Fallon refuses to see Blake; Jeff falls in love with Claudia, who is caught stealing from Denver-Carrington; Fallon's baby undergoes emergency surgery; Claudia's husband and daughter are believed dead.

A blood test proves that Blake is Fallon's true father; Steven travels to Hollywood in search of his wife; Claudia learns her husband and daughter are believed to be dead; as Krystle struggles with an armed Claudia, the gun discharges.
Claudia is hospitalized after the shooting incident; Krystle is implicated. Logan Rhinewood continues to amass Devner-Carrington; Cecil proposes marriage to Alexis.
Claudia remains confused following the accident; Jeff urges Fallon to reconcile; Steven is blackmailed by a young drifter.
Steven is arrested; Alexis and Cecil plan to marry; Fallon tells Nick it's over between them; Claudia believes Fallon's baby is her now-deceased daughter Lindsay.

Middle Eastern oilman Farouk, anxious for vengeance against Blake, tells Nick that Carrington is responsible for the death of his brother. Nick attacks Blake, who is left unconscious at the bottom of a deep ravine.

Krystle finds Blake in the mountains and gets him to the hospital. Nick Toscanni disappears. Cecil is also brought to the hospital, and he's very weak. A police investigation has started to find the baby.

Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

programmes.d: A woman accuses her former friends of starving her horses; two pit bulls are accused of attacking a border collie, causing it serious throat injuries.
A couple attempt to recover more than $12,000 in property damages from a former tenant.
One of the judges is so appalled by a defendant's behavior that she decides to take the law into her own hands.

programmes.st: Dying Wish Denied?!; Biggest Grin Award
programmes.d: After a woman passes away, her grandson and best friend fight over her property; a defendant cannot seem to wipe the grin off her face.

programmes.st: Family Heirloom Goes Missing; Own It and Move On!
programmes.d: The only link to a woman's deceased mother is mishandled and lost by a private moving company; a teen's mother says an insurance company harassed her with a scary voice.

programmes.st: Pregnant Ex-Fiance Woes; Starter Bike Stall!

Ricky books a two-month summer job in Maine and decides to take Lucy and Little Ricky. For the summer, they want to sublet their apartment at a profit, but their friends and landlords, the Mertzes, are not in favor.

Ricky Ricardo hires business manager Mr. Hickox to solve the family budget problems. Lucy, dissatisfied with her new $5 per month allowance, manages to find a loophole in the business manager's system.

Lucy agrees to help her neighbor Fred Mertz impress an old vaudeville buddy who's in town for a visit. Lucy poses as the Mertzes maid "Bessie" to make Barney Kurtz believe Fred hit it big in real estate.
Lucy feigns a crisis to test Ricky's love after hearing a story about a woman whose husband ignored her pleas for help while being robbed—she assumes Ricky would turn his back on her too.
Lucy plays Cupid and tries to bag a bachelor for a husband-hungry girlfriend. Lucy organizes an evening to show her unmarried friends, Dorothy and Sam, how wonderful marriage is.

Ricky agrees reluctantly to host a new television show, sponsored by Phipps Department Store, and learns they'd like him to host with his wife Lucy. When Lucy finds out that Ricky didn't want her in the show, she sets out to sabotage the program.
When Ben Benjamin arrives at the Ricardos' apartment, Lucy mistakes Ben Benjamin, a Hollywood talent scout, for a burglar and nearly ruins Ricky's chance for a film career.
Lucy sees Ricky's screen test as an opportunity to get discovered as a new movie star.

Lucy Ricardo meets her Spanish-speaking mother-in-law for the first time and her efforts to be a gracious host turn disastrous. Lucy's inability to speak Spanish and her in-law's inability to understand Lucy's pantomime erects a wall of misunderstanding.

Despite the reservations of her husband, Lucy decides to help Fred pick out a birthday present for Ethel. She picks out a pair of toreador pants, which Ethel thinks are unflattering as well as too big.
Ricky Ricardo paces the floor, awaiting word from Hollywood about his screen test. Lucy can't use the phone for fear the line will be busy when Ben Benjamin tries to call for Ricky.

A movie contract for Ricky necessitates a change in scenery and the hanging of a "for rent" sign on the Ricardos' New York home. The Mertzes, willing to give up tenants but not friends, sign on for the trip.

For their trip out west, Ricky buys a new car to replace the old, beat-up one Fred bought. Lucy convinces her husband to teach her how to drive it. After one driving lesson, Ricky is a harried and beaten man.

Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes have a hard time finding accommodations that will please everyone on their trip to California. Ricky is driving and sacrifices his passengers' appetites for the sake of making mileage.
The Ricardos and the Mertzes are arrested when they're caught speeding in Bent Fork, Tennessee. Although Ricky just wants to pay the fine, Lucy protests that they are being treated unfairly.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes, on the last leg of their NY-to-Hollywood motor trek, stop at Ethel's hometown of Albuquerque, New Mexico. Under the impression that Ethel has been called to Hollywood by the movies, the townsfolk give her the star treatment.

After five weeks on the road driving across the country, the Ricardos and the Mertzes arrive at their destination – Hollywood. With stars in her eyes, Lucy heads for the Brown Derby, a restaurant frequented by celebrities, with Ethel and Fred in tow.

Lucy is jealous when Ricky is asked to pose with five beautiful starlets for publicity photos and tries to get herself in on the action by inserting herself into every shot. Lucy is even more upset when Ricky goes to his first Hollywood premiere.

Lucy is desperate to appear in a Hollywood movie after hearing the Mertzes have bit parts in an upcoming feature. She sets out to be "discovered" and lands a part in an MGM musical. She plays a showgirl in a glamorous nightclub scene but has some trouble.

Lucy convinces Ricky to allow her to buy a Don Loper dress so she'll fit in with the Hollywood scene. Lucy and Ethel hit the couturier's salon but soon realize the dresses are way out of their price range.

Lucy arrives in Hollywood with Little Ricky to meet her husband and his new press agent, who intends on making Ricky the "Cuban Liberace." Charlie Pomerantz plans a publicity stunt he hopes will get Ricky into Hedda Hopper's gossip column.

Lucy learns her husband's film Don Juan will be shelved and works frantically with the Mertzes and Mrs. McGillicuddy to prevent it from happening. Together they write hundreds of fan letters and dress up as members of the Ricky Ricardo Fan Club.

Lucy has agreed to write an article entitled "What It's Like To Be Married To Ricky Ricardo" for a magazine when she learns from Ricky's press agent that Ricky is going to host a TV show. Lucy desperately wants to appear on the show with Ricky.

Ricky forgot the date of his 15th anniversary and desperately wires the records department in Greenwich, Connecticut where they were married to find out. In his defense, Ricky tells Lucy that he's already planned a big "surprise" anniversary party.
Lucy learns a movie star, Cornel Wilde, is staying in the penthouse directly above the Ricardos' apartment and sets out to catch a glimpse of the handsome actor.

Lucy and Ricky, and Fred and Ethel are fed up with each other's annoying habits and decide they all need a break. They split up for a brief vacation and Lucy and Ethel decide they'll go to Palm Springs for a girls-only good time.

Lucy's friend Caroline Abbleby decides she'll pay Lucy a visit while on her way to Hawaii, and can't wait for Lucy to introduce her to all the stars she has supposedly befriended. Lucy's only solution is to trick her friend and set the stage for deceit.
Caroline Appleby is visiting from New York and is excited to see all the stars Lucy had promised. Of course Lucy exaggerated her access to celebrities but plans on fooling her nearsighted friend.

Lucy decides that Ricky needs an agent to negotiate more money and cut down on his fruitless personal appearances, so she appoints herself. Her fast talking, no-nonsense actions result in the studio canceling Ricky's contract.
Although Ricky is having lunch with Richard Widmark, he refuses to introduce Lucy because she has become a legend around Hollywood for her crazy escapades.
The Ricardos are going back to New York in one week and Lucy is determined not to leave Hollywood with the proper souvenirs. She's already got a box full of memorabilia but she still wants more.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.
It's every man and woman for themselves when the artists tattoo any design in any style before a blind critique from the judges.
In a test of consistency, the teams must engrave full suits of armor, then a cross-stitch style elimination tattoo throws all the artists for a loop.
The artists go head-to-head in a test of technical application, and the losers fight for their survival in an elimination tattoo challenge dictated by the victors.
The artists think outside the box as they show their understanding of color theory, then get a crash course in new school style from their coaches Jime Litwalk and Kelly Doty.
Composition must be perfect as the remaining competitors draw freehand tattoos on their canvases, and coaches James Vaughn and Megan Jean Morris offer the artists advice.
Every decision counts as the artists choose someone else's tattoo design and make it their own in a true test of adaptability.
As the women's team plots to dismantle the men's team, the judges unveil a combination of detail design and cover-up challenges that are helmed by two domineering coaches.

programmes.st: Put Your Ink Where Your Mouth Is
programmes.d: With only seven competitors remaining, the canvases hold all the power as the artists are challenged to out-market their rivals and work outside their creative comfort zones.
The artists paint custom wheelchair spoke guards in the flash challenge and show finesse as they take on difficult back-of-the-neck tattoos in the elimination tattoo.
The final five artists are tasked with creating murals using paintball guns, then must work across disciplines in a traditional illustrative portrait elimination challenge.
To earn a spot in the finale, the final four artists endure a grueling, blind-judged tattoo marathon and then endeavor to reinterpret a rival's best work.
Seven coaches compete in the Clash of the Coaches Face-Off, the final three artists unveil their 35-hour back pieces, and one artist wins $100,000 and the Ink Master title.
The artists tattoo their home states and face blind critiques by the judges, a competitor makes a drastic choice, and patriotic tattoos decide someone's fate in the Face Off.

programmes.st: Ink Master Clash of the Collages
programmes.d: The South aims to unify and rebound when the teams are tasked with a postcard mural on the side of a bus, and a compass rose elimination tattoo includes a game-changing twist.

programmes.st: Ink Master Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
programmes.d: Teams must unify or die in a two-day tattoo marathon that's all about collaboration, then the losers fight for survival with full-bodied American traditional fairy tattoos.
To test legibility, the teams spin intricate designs with yarn on outdoor canvases, then get technical with schematic tattoos.

programmes.st: Ink Master Out of Your Element
programmes.d: To test their consistency, each team must work on a single canvas at the same time to create a tattoo series representing either earth, wind, water or fire.
Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo
programmes.d: Akitoki and Inuyasha travel the shrine of the wind and thunder gods to make an offering to seal away the blade's demon powers.

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!
programmes.d: Hoshiyomi uses the Kon blade to steal the Tessaiga's demon powers.

programmes.st: Eternal Love: The Naginata of Kenkon
programmes.d: Tsukiyomi, who is supposed to be dead, possesses Kagome and appears before Hoshiyomi.
Naraku's baby is bringing virtuous priests close to death and peering into their minds. He is trying to peer into the space between this world and the next.
Naraku's baby was split into two. One half comes back to life in the form of a child dressed in white.
Kanta is an otter demon child. His father's head was taken by Hakudoshi, and he is looking for his father's body.
The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.

programmes.st: Bizarre Guards at the Border of the Afterlife
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang arrive in the land of fire. They discover a giant gateway within a cave in the mountains.

programmes.st: The Fiery Bird Master, Princess Abi
programmes.d: When the gateway in the Land of Fire opened, Kagome sensed the presence of the Sacred Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 1
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 2
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.
In order to defeat Naraku, Kagura looks for Sesshomaru. She appears before Rin and Jaken, but Sesshomaru is away.

programmes.st: The Mysterious Light that Guides the Saint
programmes.d: Kagome and the others sense Kikyo's presence from the purifying arrow. Meanwhile, Abihime attacks the village.

programmes.t: Inuyasha Movie 1: Affections Touching Across Time (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Inuyasha and his friends must stop the powerful demon Menomaru from taking control of the world!

programmes.t: Inuyasha Movie 3: Swords of an Honorable Ruler (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Inuyasha and Sesshomaru must unite against the Sounga, a force that spells doom for all mankind.

programmes.t: Inuyasha Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Inuyasha faces the Four War Gods and the past he left behind on Horai Island fifty years ago.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Overcame Time…and the Boy Who Was Just Overcome
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, the half demon Inuyasha was sealed away by the priestess Kikyo. Many years later he is revived by Kagome.
Kagome finds out that she may be the reincarnation of Kaede's late older sister, the priestess Kikyo, who sealed Inuyasha with her arrow.

programmes.st: Down the Rabbit Hole and Back Again
programmes.d: Kagome has the ability to see pieces of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha has the power to defeat demons. Both of their powers are needed to gather the shards of the jewel.
Kagome has returned to the present day and is relaxing in her home when Inuyasha comes looking for her. Some of Yura's demonic hair is on his body.
Kagome learns that Inuyasha is a half demon, born of a human mother and a dog demon.
The muonna makes Inuyasha reveal the location of his father's grave.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Jane must get over the newest hurdle in her life, which proves to be harder than she hoped. Rogelio discovers that he and River are not as equal as he thought. Meanwhile, Jane and Petra must deal with the children not getting along.
After talking to everyone else about what is going on in her life, Jane turns to Petra, who she knows will give her a straight answer. In return, Petra leans on Jane for advice about JR.

Jane reluctantly agrees to let Rogelio throw her a big 30th birthday party. Jane's mentor gives her some important advice that may help her start writing again. Meanwhile, Petra thinks she and JR are finally in a good place.

Jane struggles with giving Rafael his space after she discovers that he is hiding a secret. Jane and Michael uncover clues about what happened the day he "died." Petra wants to fit into JR's world and enlists Jane's help.

Jane is trying to go with the flow, so when Michael makes a suggestion that takes her out of her comfort zone, Jane decides to go for it. Jane struggles with her feelings for Raphael while Michael slides back into his old life.

Jane is having a hard time dealing with Rafael avoiding her, so when an issue with Mateo comes up she uses it to get some face time. Rogelio turns to Jane for help when he learns his pilot is in trouble.

When Jane and Rogelio join forces to pitch a pilot, Jane is excited until she discovers a secret about her book being published. Alba and Jorge make an important decision about their future together. Rafael asks Jane to allow Luisa to meet Mateo.
When Rogelio tells Jane that the network wants her to write the script for their telenovela, at first she is excited, but begins to struggle balancing her time between that and her novel.

With Jorge officially moved into Alba's house with his stuff, it quickly has changed the dynamic, making Jane to uncomfortable. Rafael and Jane work on their co-parenting of Mateo now that they have a potential way to help Mateo.

After Rafael witnesses Mateo's behavior at school, he wants to take a different approach to his treatment. Rogelio is paranoid that River is plotting her revenge against him. Meanwhile, Jane convinces Petra to go on a single ladies' night out.

Sherri is suing her ex-husband for her son's unpaid medical bill and emotional distress.
Aisha claims Antwan harassed her and posted an explicit photo of her on social media without her permission.
Ebony is here to get help for her brother who's opioid addiction worsened after his wife overdosed.
Trying to regain custody of her children, Shamika wants to prove that her ex is the father of her youngest child.

programmes.st: You Sold Me A Sick Puppy!

Darral has been brought to court after towing Chester's car who he believes was carelessly double parked illegally.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
David is suing William after testifying for him in criminal court, and wants to be paid the wages he's owed.

Miguel is suing his friend of 30 years because he believes the defendant is the cause of his dog's death.

After stumbling across a cloning machine, Adam Baker creates multiple versions of himself and finds the answer to handling his many summer responsibilities!
A team of six clever kids enacts a daring plan to track down a swindler and bring him to justice.

Quincy is a thirty-something baggage handler by day and online video game master by night. Perfectly happy to live in his parents' home, Quincy has dedicated his life to being the best cyber athlete online, until his parents decide to move.

Freshly hatched bee, Maya can't help but make friends with all kinds of other bugs, including a young hornet named Sting. When the Royal Jelly is stolen, the hornets are the prime suspects and Maya is thought to be their accomplice.

programmes.t: Maya The Bee 2: The Honey Games
programmes.d: After a slow harvest season, the survival of the hive is threatened. Maya and Willy go to Buzztropolis, where the Empress invites them to participate in the Honey Games. But if they lose, the hive will have to give the Empress all of their summer honey!

In a world filled with Mad Scientists and Evil Inventions, one talented evil scientist's hunch-backed lab assistant has big dreams of becoming a Mad Scientist himself and winning the annual Evil Science Fair.
When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.
An animated film about a barnyard rooster (the voice of Glen Campbell) who goes to Las Vegas and finds success as an Elvis-impersonating nightclub singer.
In futuristic Metro City, scientist Tenma (voiced by Nicolas Cage) creates an amazing robot boy with hidden talents unlike anything you've ever seen.
When a hero astronaut from the blue-alien planet Baab (Brendan Fraser) gets trapped on a notoriously dangerous planet called Earth, his risk-averse brother (Rob Corddry) must save him.

When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend.

On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.”

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: Inside the Maze
programmes.d: Arin continues his investigation into the missing Horns but makes time for Frak, who Sora suspects is working for Ras and Nya's first match pits her against Jay, still with no memory of their past.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: United We Fall
programmes.d: In her match against Cinder, Wyldfyre's temper proves a liability in and out of the arena, and in order to stay in the Tournament, the Ninja invoke an ancient rule that requires them to compete in a race outside of Temple City.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: Truth and Lies
programmes.d: Arin grapples with Ras's accusation that Master Wu caused the Merge while the Ninja complete the Temple Race and win their way back into the Tournament.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: The Sword Shatters
programmes.d: Arin follows a lead in his investigation of the missing horns to the Temple City Museum; a tour from Roby reveals a deeper connection between the Tournament and Source Dragons.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: Clues and Suspects
programmes.d: Roby and Bleckt visit an injured Lloyd to complete the transfer of Zeatrix's powers as Arin links Bleckt to a clue in his investigation and follows him back to a secret office, where Wyldfyre has an idea to uncover his plans.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: The Final Game
programmes.d: Arin learns a devastating secret about the Merge and confronts Lloyd as Cole stays behind to protect the dragon horns. Sora faces off against Nokt, and Wyldfyre is too late to stop the manipulation of the games.

programmes.t: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising: Elements of Betrayal
programmes.d: Arin, Zane, and Cole make a shocking discovery in the Monastery of Gates as they defend the Dragon Horns; the depowered Elemental Masters clash with the Wolf Mask army.
The old Lava Monsters are back! And a Forbidden Power is in the middle of their new village of Burningham.
Macy is mad! The three Harpies have kidnapped her mom, Queen Halbert. The NEXO KNIGHTS use everything in their power to rescue her.
The Cloud of Monstrox is growing more and more powerful with every Forbidden Power Jestro inserts. The capital of Knighton is under attack.
Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party.
Arin nurses Ras back to health as they continue his training, meanwhile their trail leads the Ninja into more danger.
Arin ventures into a dangerous new land to heal Ras while Nya and Kai come up with a plan to make Jay come to them.
Zane's search for Arin leads to an old friend but lands him in the middle of the Forbidden Five's hunt for the Prismatic Blades.
The Ninja learn of the Forbidden Five's quest to collect the Prismatic Blades, meanwhile Ras finally leads Arin to his parents.
Sora, Nya and Riyu are summoned to New Djinjago to help a friend, and the mystery bounty hunter receives a new mission.
The mystery bounty hunter tracks Ras and Arin to the World Forest, while the Ninja search for the last Prismatic Blade.
Arin must choose between Ras and the Ninja as the battle for the Prismatic Blades rages across the World Forest.
In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole.
Chen pits everyone against each other in a ludicrous roller skating event called Thunderblade  and all contestants team up against the Ninja.
The Ninja have a secret alliance of elemental fighters, Cole has found Zane and Nya is a spy within Chen’s Kabuki to figure out what nefarious plot Chen is up to.
Nya has proof of Chen’s plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first.

After stealing the remaining contestant’s powers, Chen only needs Lloyd’s power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets about his parents.

Chen has failed to bring the return of the Serpentine War but Clouse reveals there’s another way – his daughter has the ability to absorb the power of every fighter she comes across, so she can complete the ceremony.
The Ninja reunite with Wu and turn to the aid of a shrunken Pythor in order to figure out how to defeat the unstoppable Anacondrai.
Set in the past, the dream chaser duo Hannah and Beau argue while young Oz searches for Lunia.
Zoey tries to rebuild a relationship with her estranged dad and Logan steps up his training to beat Astrid.
A close call with the Never Witch places Mateo in the forests of Wildoria while Beau is on an adventure in the dream world with Zoey.
Zoey and Mateo are trapped in the Grim Realm while Izzie is suspicious of MadTeo's true identity.
An attack by the Never Witch draws the dream chasers to the Dunes of Duralumina, leaving Nova and Sneak to handle an incursion on their own.
Attempting to track the Never Witch using Oz's powerful telescope, the booby traps surprise the dream chasers at Oz and Albert's landing.
Fearing for the fate of the Candy Realm, the dream chasers evacuate its inhabitants while Mateo and Astrid infiltrate the Midnight Raven.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Harl Hubbs Day/Ann They're Off
programmes.d: It's Harl Hubbs Day and Harl decides to help the whole city but quickly discovers he wasn't prepared for Harl mania! Billy's mother, Ann, accepts a junkyard race challenge against the city's street racing legend, Tread Octane.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Bob and Clemmons' Excellent Adventure/The Man With No Name With A Name
programmes.d: We pull back the curtain to see how Firemen Bob and Clemmons retrieve the bizarre requests of Chief Freya during a typical emergency. It's an old west showdown when a new adversary rolls into town.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Daisy Chain Gang/Backdraft to School
programmes.d: Fendrich organizes a charity as a distraction while he attempts to steal the city deed. Sinclair gathers antiheroes to stop him. Freya is one credit short of graduating from the fire academy and is suspended as Fire Chief.
