Jack meets an old flame at the park who is seeking advice about her jealous husband. Furley joins them, and they all get poison oak. Later, at Jack's house, Furley tells the husband they were all in the bushes together.
Chrissy falls for an older man she meets at the supermarket. Jack is jealous, but he's even more upset when Mr. Roper tells Jack and Janet that she knows the man's wife. Guest Star(s): Dick Sargeant
Jack challenges a famous food critic to sample his cuisine, aiming for a favorable review in his newspaper column.

programmes.st: Now You See It, Now You Don't
programmes.d: When Jack attends a charity ball with a socialite and loses $15,000 gambling, Larry and the girls attempt to help him recover the money.
Jack becomes a hit with TV viewers when he botches a cooking demonstration promoting Angelino's restaurant.
A tiny tyke terrorizes Jack and Chrissy with the threat of tears after Janet presses them into service as inexperienced, substitute sitters.
Chrissy gets a new job selling cosmetics door-to-door, and unexpectedly finds herself in Ralph Furley's winner-take-all strip poker game.
While Stanley Roper is selling the apartment building as a wedding anniversary surprise, his wife catches him with the attractive real estate agent and believes her marriage is breaking up.
Jack and Chrissy offer to baby-sit for Stanley Roper's parakeet in exchange for a couple of concert tickets.
Jack Tripper finally meets his match when a devilish 12-year-old boy wins the girls' sympathy and moves into the apartment.
Jack and Chrissy apparently do Janet a disfavor by talking her into trying for a promotion at the florist shop where she works.
Jack and Chrissy hatch an outrageous scheme to transform sensible Janet into a high-powered bombshell in order to cool off the amorous advances of Larry.
Larry completely trusts Jack to show his teenage sister around town - until he discovers that they are still out at 2 a.m.
Terri and Jack believe that Janet will have to make it with her dance instructor if she wants to make it as a dancer.

Jack is dating a sex therapist who has asked him to keep her job a secret. Janet, concluding she is a prostitute, is nasty to her and no one can understand why - especially when Janet's own father has become so friendly with her.
Janet moves in with Mrs. Roper while Mr. Roper is away on business, then stews about Jack and Chrissy being alone for the night in the trio's upstairs apartment.
Jack snows a stunning skier named Inga into believing he's a downhill champion.
Jack finds himself in a state of panic when he juggles three gourmet dinners in three different apartments.
Jack adopts a new image and changes his career plans to please an affluent woman who'd like to marry him.
Chrissy, whose skills in the kitchen aren't exactly sharp, invites a gourmet to share a home-cooked dinner, then pleads with Jack to be her secret stand-in-chef.
Janet buys a blonde wig and is so taken with her new image that she alienates her roommates, Furley, and a new neighbor as well.

Jack and Furley get locked in a freezer together. Convinced they are going to die, they have a heart-to-heart talk, and Jack confesses that he really isn't gay. Once safe, Jack worries because Furley knows the truth about him.
Janet is happy that her old friend, Randy, is dating Jack - until she discovers that Randy is married.
Roper's on a rampage for the rent so Jack's visiting uncle, a charming rascal, passes him a bad check.
Chrissy nearly loses her job when Jack tries to save her from the lecherous advances of the firm's president.
Mysterious phone calls and secret meetings lead Jack, Janet, and Chrissy to believe that Helen Roper is having an illicit fling with her husband's best friend.

programmes.st: She Loves Me, She Loves Me Not
programmes.d: Larry discovers an answered magazine quiz and he and Jack think one of the girls wants to have an affair with Jack. They take the girls on a weekend trip to find out who answered the quiz so Jack can talk her out of it.

Larry's sly suggestion that he and Jack trade apartments after Jack has a tiff with the girls gives lustful Larry the chance to really put the move on Janet and Cindy.
After a happily-married computer-matched couple sells Jack on the merits of computer dating, the fun begins when Jack secretly signs up.
Terri thinks an attractive older woman's visit to Jack are weekly lessons in lovemaking and, in disgust, decides to move out.
Jack challenges a guy who has insulted Furley to a boxing match. His opponent, the girls learn, is a Golden Glove contender with 22 knockouts.
Jack and Janet face the danger of losing Chrissy to a fast-talking guru who dazzles her into believing her place is at his side - in a distant commune.

On August 13th, 2022, Teofimo Lopez fought Pedro Campa for the NABF & WBO International Super Lightweight Titles in Las Vegas. Teofimo looked confident and quick from the start, wearing down Campa until he finally stopped him in the 7th round.

On October 17th, 2020 Teofimo Lopez and Vasiliy Lomachenko battled for IBF, WBA and WBO World Lightweight title in The Bubble at MGM Grand in Las Vegas in a 12 round bout that ended in victory for Lopez.

On July 14th, 2018 Teofimo Lopez and William Silva fought for the vacant WBC Continental Americas lightweight titles with Silva going down 3 times Lopez secured the technical knockout win in the sixth round.
On April 14th, 2012 Terence Crawford fought Andre Gorges at the Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas in a bout that was set for 6 round and lasted 5 with a win by knockout victory for Crawford.

programmes.t: Terence Crawford vs Jose Benavidez Jr
programmes.d: On October 13th, 2018, Terence Crawford fought Jose Benavidez Jr for the WBO World Welterweight Title in Omaha, Nebraska. In a dominant performance, Crawford showed out in front of his hometown, delivering a TKO in the final round.

On August 19th, 2017 Terence Crawford fought Julius Indongo for the IBF, WBA, WBC and WBO  World Super Lightweight titles at the Pinnacle Bank Arena in Lincoln the bout ended in the third round by knockout securing the victory for Crawford.

On November 14th, 2020 Terence Crawford battled Kell Brook for the WBO World Welterweight title in The Bubble at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas resulting in a fourth round technical knockout victory for Crawford.

On November 20th, 2021, Terence Crawford fought Shawn Porter for the WBO World Welterweight Title at the Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas. In a very close fight, Crawford turned it up and put on the pressure late, delivering a TKO in the 10th round.

On April 18th, 2015, Terence Crawford fought Thomas Dulorme for the WBO World Super Lightweight Title in Arlington, Texas. Putting on the pressure and showing his aggressive style, Crawford scored three knockdowns in the sixth round to get the TKO.

On July 23rd, 2016, Terence Crawford fought Viktor Postol for the WBO and WBC World Super Lightweight Titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Scoring two knockdowns, Crawford dominated the fight, earning a much deserved unanimous decision victory.

On June 28th, 2014, Terence Crawford fought Yuriorkis Gamboa for the WBO Lightweight Title at Century Link Center in Omaha. In Top Rank's 2014 Fight of the Year, Terence Crawford shined in front of his hometown, stopping Gamboa in the ninth round.

programmes.t: Thomas Hearns vs Juan Domingo Roldan
programmes.d: On October 29th, 1987 Thomas Hearns faced Juan Domingo Roldan for the vacant WBC World Middleweight title at the Las Vegas Hilton the 12 round bout went only 4 rounds ending with a knockout by Hearns securing the victory.

On June 15th, 1984 Thomas Hearns fought Roberto Duran for WBC World Super Welterweight title at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas that resulted in a technical knockout victory in the second round by Hearns.

programmes.t: Timothy Bradley Jr vs Kendall Holt
programmes.d: On April 4th, 2009, Timothy Bradley Jr fought Kendall Holt for the WBC and WBO Light Welterweight Titles at the Bell Centre in Montreal. Holt scored two knockdowns to keep the fight close, but Bradley stayed aggressive enough to earn the decision.

programmes.t: Timothy Bradley Jr vs Ruslan Provodnikov
programmes.d: On March 16th, 2013, Timothy Bradley fought Ruslan Provodnikov for the WBO Welterweight Title in Carson, California. Provodnikov put up a very strong challenge in an incredible fight, but Bradley prevailed, earning a unanimous decision victory.

programmes.t: Timothy Bradley vs Manny Pacquiao I
programmes.d: On June 9th, 2012 Manny Pacquiao and Timothy Bradley started their trilogy at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas in a battle for the WBO World Welterweight title that ended in a split decision win for Timothy Bradley.
On August 6th, 1992 Todd Foster fought Jeff Mayweather at Denton Field in Miles City with Mayweather going down in rounds 7 & 8 the bout resulted in a technical knockout victory for Foster.

On June 7th, 1993 Tommy Morrison battled George Foreman for the WBO world heavyweight title at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas with Foreman getting a point deducted in round ten the bout resulted in a victory for Morrison.

On October 9th, 2021, Tyson Fury fought Deontay Wilder in their third and final matchup against each other at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. In a thrilling fight, Fury once again proved his dominance, defeating Wilder by an 11th-round TKO.

Theorists suggest that compelling evidence of extraterrestrial visitation exists in China, the cradle of one of the earliest and most influential civilizations on Earth.

As the kids prepare for a big play, Rex is accidentally sucked into a giant fan and Tori is responsible.  Robbie is an emotional wreck, and it's up to Tori to save the day by saving Rex's life.
Sikowitz recruits the gang to form a children's band for a friend's party.  When a leaked video of the group's performance becomes popular, Andre struggles to be taken seriously as a musician.

Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.
Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.
The kids are excited to hear that they'll be the stars of a new reality show being filmed at Hollywood Arts. Meanwhile, Trina and Robbie are forced to work at The Grub Truck after injuring Festus.
Tori discovers that her friends have been secretly going to a fancy restaurant instead of playing in an annual ping pong tournament.
Tori agrees to help Jade find a theater to perform a play Jade wrote. But when the sponsor demands changes that will ruin Jade's play, Tori has to make things right before opening night.

A heat wave hits LA and the gang heads for the beach in Beck's RV. But once there, they find themselves trapped inside the RV as the temperature rises. Oblivious, Cat parties it up with some cute boys.
Tori's flight home is delayed, leaving her no time to finish a school project with her friends. She attempts to get the work done with them over video chat, but things keep getting in the way.

Tori's friends sing at a local karaoke club and end up competing with a pair of stuck-up girls who are regular performers there. Competing with those girls proves to be more difficult than they expect, since one of the girls' father owns the club.
Tori auditions for a role in a movie. But after exaggerating on her resume, she gets hired as a stunt double. When Tori finds out her stunt is falling off a building, she's not sure she can do it.
When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade.  Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.
The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.
Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

In the series premiere, the Ewing family gathers at Southfork Ranch for an upcoming wedding. Although the occasion is joyous, secret oil drilling ignites an old feud.
The plot to take control of Southfork gets complicated. Christopher and Elena bury their feelings to work together on a business deal, but Rebecca may be hiding her own secrets.
J.R. decides to move back to Southfork, much to Ann's dismay. Bitter Ewing family enemy Cliff Barnes (KEN KERCHEVAL -- Dallas [original series]) returns.
John Ross seeks to gain an upper hand on a family member and resorts to blackmail. Christopher opens up to Bobby about his difficulty in choosing between the two women he loves.
Family ties begin to unravel when the deed to Southfork is revealed. Ann seeks help from someone in her past and Christopher decides it is time to fight dirty.
John Ross decides to move into Southfork. Rebecca approaches Bobby and Christopher with information that she believes might help save the ranch. MITCH PILEGGI guest stars.
Rebecca reveals a life-changing secret to Elena. Meanwhile, John Ross tries to turn one family member against another and a family associate is murdered.
Christopher moves closer to his dream when a large oil company approaches him about rights to new methane technology. And the Ewings fight to protect Southfork from outsiders.
John Ross learns the value of family when he must choose between blood and oil. Sue Ellen and Rebecca both find themselves victims of men who could destroy their lives.
In the dramatic season one finale, Christopher and Elena begin to learn that not everyone is as they appear to be. Long-buried secrets are revealed as the past rears its ugly head.
In the second season premiere, as Christopher seeks to gain the upper hand in his divorce from Rebecca Sutter, a game-changing revelation turns everything on its head.
Pamela Rebecca Barnes schemes with John Ross to fulfill her father's desire for revenge. Ryland's mother (JUDITH LIGHT) proves just as evil as her son.
Pamela pushes her father's agenda to gain control of Ewing Energies. As a new member of the family arrives at Southfork, Ann is pushed to the brink by Ryland's sadistic games.
J.R. works to undermine Pamela, forcing John Ross to choose between a Ewing and a Barnes. Cliff Barnes (KEN KERCHEVAL) returns to meet with an unlikely visitor.
John Ross' plot to take over Ewing Energies solidifies; Christopher changes tactics with Pamela Barnes; and an enemy from the Ewings' past resurfaces.
With Drew's help, Christopher makes a startling revelation that may change the fate of Ewing Energies. The family comes together when an outsider tries to undermine them all.
In the aftermath of John Ross and Sue Ellen's coup, Bobby's brother Gary (TED SHACKELFORD) helps him retaliate. Christopher and John Ross clash in a winner-takes-all car race.
J.R. Ewing finally meets his end. The family strives to set aside their differences and mourn together. Accompanied by many characters from J.R.'s past, the Ewings bury their own.

When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist.  Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise.  The FBI was called on to help.  Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area.  The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders.  Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes.  The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage.  Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building.  During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble.  The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom.  Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder.  Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God.  Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

In Henderson, NV, a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambush armored guards as they exit their truck on March 3, 2000.  The robbers kill both guards and seize $5,000.  As the killers run to their getaway car, a police officer arrives and opens fire, striking one escaping assailant in the leg.  After loosing the killers in a chase, police collect blood left by the injured robber and bullet casings from the firefight.

On February 12, 1997, two men use a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, NJ home.  The homeowner shoots at the intruders, hitting one in the hand before they escape.  Camden Police respond and track the suspects to a nearby park.  One of the men shoots at the officer before police arrest his accomplice.  The man gives up the identity of the shooter. Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence.  FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

This special episode of The FBI Files celebrates the groundbreaking science, investigative technique, and gut-level instinct that has made the FBI the world's premier law

In the 1970's, Otpor, a violent arm of the Croatian National Resistance commits terroristic acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the U.S.  With the help of an informant, the FBI is able to apprehend, arrest and convict members of the group for crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area.  The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders.  Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes.  The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States.  But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.  All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence.  FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

On February 12, 1997, two men use a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, NJ home.  The homeowner shoots at the intruders, hitting one in the hand before they escape.  Camden Police respond and track the suspects to a nearby park.  One of the men shoots at the officer before police arrest his accomplice.  The man gives up the identity of the shooter. Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent.  The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts.  When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder.  Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God.  Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983.  A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded.  Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect.  Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise.  But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham.  Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft.  But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun.   The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

In the late 70s and early 80s, a terrorist group known as the FALN is suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities. Their goal - to bring attention to the Puerto Rican independence movement.  As the bombings escalate, innocent lives are lost. FBI agents and police are is in a deadly race to stop this murderous group with a dangerous cause.

In Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power leads to a full-scale mob war.  The local Mafia crime family splits in two as the young and the old fight to the death.  The FBI is caught in the middle as they infiltrate the syndicate through informants and high-tech surveillance.  Agents must find a way to bring down the organization before their civil war leads to innocent causalities.

In the late 1980s, the FBI matches wits with a cunning bank robber -- a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.  The robber's planning is meticulous.  He executes his crimes with military precision.  It will take the combined skills of local police and dozens of agents  to catch a criminal mastermind they call, "The Shootist."

In Puerto Rico, violent militants are intent on turning the US Commonwealth into a communist dictatorship.  They murder a policeman, turns their guns on a busload of unarmed Navy workers, and even launch an attack on the FBI.  These ruthless killers have vowed to fight to the death.  The FBI must use every tactic at their disposal to track down the terrorists and bring them to justice.

In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary.  The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy.  The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack.   Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

Maine’s North Woods is the largest tract of undeveloped forest land east of the Rocky Mountains. The vast expanse of trees has the ability to offset 500 million metric tons of carbon dioxide from our atmosphere, which is equal to taking a million cars off the road-- for a century! Tonight, Ted Reinstein reports on the New England Forestry Foundation’s efforts to spread the word about the North Woods’ untapped potential to address the climate crisis.

Now local nonprofits, volunteers, and advocates are leading the charge to “re-wild” forests – returning them to their natural condition while protecting biodiverse habitats. We visit Mass Audubon’s Tidmarsh Wildlife Sanctuary in Plymouth, and see how the Native Land Conservancy is restoring parts of the Muddy Pond Preserve in Kingston. She also tours the Martha’s Vineyard Museum where she learns about the little-known history of Black and Native American whaling captains.

Nicole Estaphan meets clinicians, scientists, and tech pros developing and deploying advanced medical therapies -- right here in Massachusetts. She even finds a tech advancement not for humans, but for horses – a new way to treat equine asthma.

When is a bait shop more than a bait shop? When it holds generations’ worth of local history, in the form of cherished photographs. The clock Stanley gives Helen for their anniversary turns out to be stolen from Brookes' apartment.
On the day that Helen is making dinner to impress her rich sister, Ethel, the utilities are cut off because Stanley forgot to pay the bills. He goes to great lengths to hide his mistake.

Both Stanley and Jeffrey argue with their wives and walk out on them at the same time. Getting drunk at a bar brings them together as buddies, but sobering up may open their eyes to a big problem they've unwittingly created.
A fire in the kitchen leads to the Ropers having to stay with the Brookes family until their place is ready again. However, Stanley's behavior gets on Jeffrey's last nerve.

Hector tries to keep himself out of trouble by attempting to silence his henchman for good. However, he ends up in a precarious situation when his plan backfires. Busy trying to avoid being incriminated in Hector's schemes, Daniela becomes negligent of her responsibilities.

Carlos' insistence to help Romina leads to a severe argument with his wife. Unfortunately for Daniela, her problems continue when her selfish management of Camila Sardines leaves disgruntled employees in its wake.

Iris takes a pregnancy test, her mind racing with anticipation and uncertainty. Soon after, Cassandra visits her daughter, offering guidance and support that helps Iris reach an important realization.
After a heart-to-heart talk with Ali, Basti comes to a realization and develops a new game plan with Iris for their future.
As Basti and Iris prepare for their future, Cass suggests what the young couple should prioritize first. Meanwhile, Val finds another reason to get angry at Nestor over Cass.
As The Love Team continues to please its clients, Basti and Iris have no difficulty envisioning a bright future together. Meanwhile, Ali finds himself contemplating his career and life.
The Love Team takes on their biggest event yet, determined to prove themselves and cement their reputation as event organizers.
After a video of Catherine's wedding disaster goes viral, The Love Team faces a crisis. Meanwhile, Val looks for a way to win back Nestor's affection.
Basti starts his new job to keep the money flowing as The Love Team continues to struggle with its negative image, while Iris and Ali try to close a deal with a potential client.

As the Love Team continues its slump, Iris uses her free time to help with Cass’s craft business. Cass and Basti, staying in the same room longer, stir unresolved tension. Val tells Nestor she wants a baby.

Basti and Iris clash again over his dispute with Cass. As Iris plans to stay with her mother, Basti pulls her into a sudden trip so they can settle things alone. Meanwhile, Stephen keeps urging Ali to go solo.

Iman Suguitan, a luxury hotel supplier in Dubai, talks about the challenges of her business and the importance of personal growth. She also shares how she came up with a social enterprise for cacao farmers in the Philippines.
Victoria’s loved ones mourn her passing. Maila seeks justice. Lydia pleads to drop Rigor’s case.

Carlos and Roman are disappointed Gabriel returned to school. Roman’s anger grows as Gabriel bails Rigor out. Roman orders Carlos to ruin Gabriel. Meanwhile, Maila is disheartened her evidence can’t implicate Rigor more. Rigor vows on Victoria’s grave to protect their secret.

Bianca learns she’s being booted from Tiger Shark by Roman’s orders. Carlos refuses to follow, withdrawing the decision last minute. Gabriel dreams of his mother, sensing a deeper meaning. Carlos and Rigor unite for a common goal.

Things are looking up for Gabriel as his efforts to balance work and studies pay off. Like him, Bianca pursues a new job. But bad news threatens her plans. Meanwhile, Carlos tries to bring Bianca back to Tiger Shark and finds support in Rigor.

The de la Vegas plan to stop Gabriel from blaming Roman for Victoria’s death. Gabriel finds a lead on his mother’s murder, fueling his quest for justice. Carlos enjoys Rigor’s stories about Victoria, while Bianca struggles with her new job.

Carlos and Rigor form a strong alliance with their evil plan. Roman warns his son to stay away from Rigor. Meanwhile, Maila finds an ally in Roman. Gabriel faces new trouble, and Bianca discovers Tiger Shark's accounting anomalies.

Gabriel clashes with the de la Vegas and struggles after losing most of his school files. Meanwhile, a financial anomaly at Tiger Shark sparks tension between Carlos and Roman. Roman also ponders Victoria and Rigor’s secret.

Maila decides to take on a legal battle against Rigor. Lydia is deeply affected and pleads fervently with the Agbayanis to protect her son. Roman learns of Gabriel’s plan to implicate him in Victoria’s murder, and Carlos forms a new pact with Rigor.

Isabel’s attempt to win Carlos’ heart backfires due to a Tiger Shark anomaly. Roman, a Victoria murder suspect, manipulates events to clear his name. An unexpected visitor unsettles the Villorias, but Gabriel stays focused on his legal battle.

Mia Salazar, a self-destructive, alcoholic doctor who joined the Doctor to the Barrios program to heal from the tragedy of her fiance's death meets the cheerful and nerdy forester Jay Policarpio. Together, the two will embark on a new journey.
Filipino-American rapper, spoken word artist, music producer, and scientist Ruby Ibarra imparts her love and passion for hip-hop and its impact on her life.
Caroline Garcia, a Sydney-based performance artist, shares how she lives her dream by creating small art sculptures and inserting herself in films and music videos.
Upon learning of Leon’s relation with Hector, Romina goes ballistic and confronts the accused man. Leon then confesses the truth to Romina and tries to justify his lies.
The news about a helicopter crash survivor shakes the Bartolomes and the Mondragons to the core as they think of the possibility that Robert could still be alive.

As Leon learns of the story about Robert’s mishaps after the helicopter crash, he then begins to search for the man. Not wanting to give away falls hope, Leon refuses to tell Romina the information he gained about Robert.
Leon tracks down the woman who took Robert in after his escape from pirates. Unknown to him, his cousin Alvin is on his tail. Romina and Daniela race to find the missing Mondragon patriarch.
After escaping from Eva's clutches, Robert finally comes back home. His immeasurable joy, however, is cut short after hearing a disheartening news about his beloved wife, Romina.

Daniela becomes desperate and demands for Hector’s help in searching for Robert. She then mulls over her father’s inexplicable reason for going in hiding, plagued by fear of her secrets getting revealed.
Romina learns that her beloved husband is, indeed, alive. This leads her to an assumption that Daniela knows the information all along and starts to tail her stepdaughter.

Determined to acquire information about Robert’s whereabouts, Romina roams around the island only to discover a confusing lead. She then finds a way to expand the search for her husband, much to Daniela’s horror.
As the search for Robert continues, Romina gets a lead on her beloved husband's possible whereabouts. She then becomes eager to track down Eva, whom she believes is the key to finding Robert.

Entrepreneur, marketing advisor, and dot connector Roslynn Cobarrubias shares her relationship with her family and her memorable childhood experiences. She also gives a sneak peek of her job in the marketing and music industry.
Waldo and Aryann suspect foul play in Simon’s death and believe Tristan may be involved. Tristan plans to ensure that Supreme Pacific closes a deal with Boat Builders Manila.
A huge responsibility falls on Waldo’s shoulders when Tony decides to entrust Boat Builders Manila and all his estates to him. Felix threatens to harm Chesca if Tristan fails to seal the deal.
Tristan and Armand conspire as they carry out their vile plan against Waldo. Meanwhile, Waldo learns about Supreme Pacific’s bogus investors.
Waldo finds himself in a tight spot after the fishing vessel tragedy involving Boat Builders Manila. Tristan relishes Waldo’s misfortune but soon learns the consequences of his schemes.
Waldo faces the ire of the sunken fishing vessel’s victims. In the midst of the tragedy, Aryann chooses to leave Waldo, believing that she has only brought him pain.

Marlon gathers courage to recount the events before the vessel explosion. Waldo uncovers Tristan’s link to the tragedy and a gunrunning syndicate. Meanwhile, King, Rosing, Chesca, and Aryann are abducted.
Despite the risks involved, Waldo goes to the shipyard where King and Aryann are being held hostage in an attempt to rescue them. Tristan is pressured to kill Waldo in exchange for Chesca’s safety.

Waldo faces off with Tristan at the shipyard, unaware that Mr. Abrego’s daughter has planted time bombs all over the place. As soon as he discovers one of the bombs, Waldo races to save King, Chesca, Rosing, and Aryann.

Waldo races to save Aryann from the explosion. Together, they face the ultimate test of their love as they struggle to overcome the challenges before them and fight for their long-awaited happily ever after.

The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.
Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.
Certain death at the hands of the simulants lead the Dwarfers to wonder if it's the end.
The Dwarfers find themselves in an alternative reality where technology is prohibited.
Lister and Cat get trapped when investigating a shipwreck at the bottom of an ocean moon.
After an altercation with a deranged droid, Lister has his kidneys organ-napped.
After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.
Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.
A radiation leak wipes out the crew of the ship Red Dwarf, leaving only one survivor.
Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.
Lister and Cat wake up with their legs in plaster. What's going on?
The crew of Red Dwarf have found a way to go back in time three million years.
Holly has been deposed and the back-up computer Queeg 500 is in control of Red Dwarf.
Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.
Time starts to run backwards after the boys travel through a time hole.
Red Dwarf is on a collision course towards a minefield of black holes.

Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dra

In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.
The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.
After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

Deadly Desire covers the case of Jodine Serrin's murder and how forensic genealogy cracked the case.
Decades after a young woman's murder, her killer is identified using a revolutionary DNA method.
In 2018, two paralegals are shot dead while at work in Scottsdale, Ariz.
A beloved local teacher is brutally attacked in her Pennsylvania home; police trace her killer.
March Massacre follows the case of Barbara Becker and how familial DNA led to her murderer.
Unrighteous Act follows the investigation into the brutal murder of Karen Klaas.
A lorry driver is found dead behind the wheel in England; police use familial DNA analysis.
Blood Bath is the harrowing story of Melanie Road's murder and how police never gave up hope.
Road Trip to Hell is about a fun road trip that turned into a real-life horror movie.
Police probe the Washoe County murder.
In 1994, Le Bich-Thuy is found dead; DNA and technology allow detectives to track the killer.
A decades-long police investigation includes one of the worst miscarriages of justice in UK history.
In 1973, two young girls are found murdered in the Welsh village of Llandarcy.
With the help of familial DNA, detectives are able to track down and capture a serial rapist.
Drysdale's marriage is threatened when he looks to the Clampetts for a housekeeper while his wife is away.
Charlie Trent used to be an Army scout. Now he's the town drunk. Hoss helps him regain his self-esteem when he has him volunteer to lead a gold-bearing troop through the desert.
Hoss and Little Joe are mistaken for bloodthirsty hired killers in a small Texas town dominated by two feuding families.
Police and Elly's animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.
Two of Cousin Pearl's most ardent former suitors come to visit her in Beverly Hills.
The Cartwrights come to the aid of a Chinese-American stable hand accused of murder. Opposing them is a manipulative candidate who wants all "foreigners" to leave Virginia City.
Police find Granny's still.
Duke, Jed's bloodhound, becomes matchmaker.
While hunting a predator wolf, Little Joe finds a gypsy woman who has been rejected from her people because she is believed to be a witch.
A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.
Jed is made a bank vice president so he can compete in an interbank skeet shoot.
When a powerful gang plagues Virginia City with a murderous protection racket, the Cartwrights are determined to stop it even as it threatens them.

Mrs. Drysdale wants to get rid of the Clampett's before the arrival of Mrs. Smith-Standish, the head of a 'first family' historical society. Mrs. Smith-Standish goes to the Clampetts first and becomes enchanted with their antiques and way of life. She ropes Mrs. Drysdale into helping with chores done the old way, to her horror.
Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.
After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adam's life by gunning down two men, he eventually reveals that he's in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwrights to Sacramento to testify.
Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.
Granny chases off IRS man with a gun.
The Cartwrights' neighbor Tom Edwards has lived as a paraplegic, ever since an accident involving Ben Cartwright and a gun. His ranch is going to waste.
Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.
Jed falls for beautiful Beverly Hills matron.
Jacob Darien is leading his family of Quakers through Virginia City. When he is accosted by town roughnecks, Adam Cartwright steps in with the help of his new traveling companion.
Drysdale will get a raise when he signs the Clampett account.
Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious accident.
Ranchers are being killed, cattle stolen, and even after former U.S. Deputy Marshal Denver McKee sends posses after the suspects, they are never found.
Prejudice erupts on both sides when Ben gives an Indian named Matsou and his wife some of his land, after saving Ben's life from a renegade Indian who almost killed him.
The Clampetts have a series of unusual encounters with a Beverly Hills psychiatrist.
A Beverly Hills psychiatrist pursues Granny instead of Pearl when Granny's love potion misfires.
Jennifer Beale is abducted in the hopes her rich father, Joshua, the richest silver baron on the Comstock, will pay a $1M ransom.
Clampetts offer to help at Drysdale's bank.
Clampetts show Jethros's friend how to have fun.
Dolly Kincaid is so fed up with her extremely dominant, controlling, sheriff father, that she runs away with her boyfriend.
Jed fakes an illness to please Granny.
Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.
Gunnar is a long-lost relative of the Cartwright family. When Gunnar arrives at the Ponderosa, the family takes him in for the evening.
Her neighbors are aghast when Granny decides to start a vegetable garden on the mansion grounds.
A new fashion patterned after the Clampetts comes to Beverly Hills.
After Joe kills a man in self-defense who tried to set fire to the Ponderosa, he has to take his feisty daughter home, and she and her relatives are now determined to kill Joe.
Jethro, after a man-to-man talk with Jed, wastes no time in finding a girlfriend.
Love-struck Jethro decides he wants to "marry up" with Chickadee Laverne, a brassy burlesque dancer he brought home.
The Cartwrights try to disprove the validity of a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from seizing part of the Ponderosa and the Carson Valley settlers' lands.
Jed receives news that his multimillion-dollar account is overdrawn by $34.70.
The Clampetts, under the noxious influence of J.D. Clampett, impostor and unemployed actor, go to Hollywood.
About to set out on a cattle drive, Ben hires a young drifter named Sam Jackson as one of his drovers, but Jackson is really outlaw determined to kill his father, Waycross sheriff.
Mrs. Drysdale's turkey escapes to the Clampett household.
Clampetts attend Drysdale garden party when told not to.
Adam rides up on some Indians wanting to harm a white woman they believed was a mountain spirit. He kills them but the rest of the tribe is still out there looking for her.
Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.
Clampetts have trouble getting acquainted with neighbors.
Angry with the way a beautiful deaf-mute girl is treated by her father Little Joe takes it upon himself to teach her sign language, but the young woman falls in love with him.
The Clampetts are somewhat befuddled by their Christmas gifts, all from Mr. Drysdale.
Granny gets a date for Elly with a TV western star.
Hoss mentors a lonely man who, with superhuman size and strength, becomes extremely dangerous when angered, when they come across a saloon girl who wants a protector.
When 16-year-old Todd Grayson arrives from Boston to Virginia City, he is told that his father has been killed by Ben Cartwright. The boy goes to avenge his father.
An Australian banker sends Drysdale a kangaroo as a joke and Granny thinks she has discovered a giant jackrabbit.
Old beau shows up to marry Jethro for his money.
Hoss falls prey to the wiles of a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money in spite of Adam's proof to the contrary.
Backwoods freeloader Lafe Crick lingers on at the Clampett mansion as an unwanted guest in search of an easy fortune.
The confusion over Lou's new business relationship with Matt continues to mount.
The new truck arrives, fueling the growing feud between Team Lou and Team Matt.
After Froy's injury on a repo, tensions between Lou and Matt reach new heights.
Lou's new business relationship with Matt starts to unravel when a botched job puts a strain on the company.
Tensions between Lou and Matt continue to boil when Matt enlists his daughter's aid on another job.
A new rift between Matt and the rest of the crew puts the fate of the team in question.
On this season finale, Matt and Lou have their final confrontation and the team loses a member.
On this season premiere, Sonia's rehabilitation from her gunshot wound takes a shocking turn.
Sonia's recovery takes another unexpected turn when she goes too far with a debtor.
Things get a lot more complicated for the team when Sonia puts herself on the business end of a knife.
The repo team confronts the toughest challenge yet: one-on-one interviews with an anger management specialist.
The team gets back to work, but have their anger management sessions had any effect?
The team's work with the anger management specialist starts to pay off with disastrous consequences.
Matt and Froy crash a meeting to ask for a car, but instead they get an angry old man with a rifle.
Sonia and Froy disrupt a wild debtor, clash with workers, and face a repo that ends in destruction.
Lou, Sonia repo from yuppie; Sonia, Matt, Froy reclaim from hippie; Matt, Sonia confront fire dancers.
Sonia and Froy show off their best moves against a team of dance instructors.
Lou and Sonia are caught in a desperate situation when the owner of their target car is struck.
Sonia and Lou find themselves in the middle of nowhere in a tooth-and-nail fight with a trio of stargazers.
Froy and Sonia are overwhelmed by a swarm of cheerleaders.
Lou and Froy repo an airplane, but Froy finds himself in handcuffs when Lou takes off.
Matt and Froy repo a car from a girl whose roommate has been keeping two very big secrets.
While attempting a repo of a "green energy" bio-diesel vehicle, Froy's lack of knowledge sets the bus ablaze.
Sonia and Matt go to a garden center to repo a forklift, but a language barrier causes chaos.
With the pressure of Froy's legal problems mounting, the team tries to convince him to hire a lawyer.
Froy meets with a lawyer, but his legal troubles are worse than expected.
While Froy waits on news from his lawyer, he considers taking matters into his own hands.
Matt and Froy head to Texas to clear Froy's name, but things take a turn for the worse.
When a debtor and his friends resort to baseball bats, chaos erupts.
Down in Texas, Matt and Froy are staking out a cement mixer, but their repo turns disastrous.
First, Frankie and Lyndah find themselves in a fancy neighborhood, dealing with a pair of uptight yuppies.
Matt and Froy face incredible odds against a Texas-sized biker gang looking for a beat down.
Matt and Froy set out to repo a truck from a wealthy Texan.
Lou takes his new guys on their very first repo.
Lou plans an elaborate sting operation to infiltrate a cult, but everything goes awry.
Froy and Sonia repo from a stranded motorist who rallies the neighborhood around his cause.
The team gets back to work, but have their anger management sessions had any effect?
Sonia and Carlos put their best performance in when they attempt to repossess a vehicle.
Froy and Matt have to wrangle with some angry clowns when they try to repossess a bouncy castle.
When Carlos plays a repossession prank that almost lands Matt and Froy in jail.
Sonia and Froy deal with an unbalanced debtor who threatens to take down the entire company.
Matt and Froy take the opportunity to enact revenge on Ronnie and Carlos.
Visita a la capital de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos.
Un paseo para descubrir Shiripuno y Tiyu Yaco, inmersas en un proyecto novedoso.
Desde Bangalore a Hassan para visitar tres magníficos templos tallados en piedra.
Kinkin bañales, explica a ander en que consiste la carrera de layas el dia de san saturnino.
Un recorrido por Puerto López, conocido por sus aguas paradisíacas y la isla de la Plata.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Bali, una isla indonesia de templos, arrozales, playas y espiritualidad única.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Edimburgo, una ciudad escocesa de castillos, callejones medievales y ambiente literario.
Un viaje a uno de los países más atractivos por sus diferencias con occidente.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Cracovia, una ciudad polaca de plazas medievales, castillos, historia y ambiente estudiantil.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Budapest, Hungría, una capital dividida por el Danubio, llena de termas, puentes y arquitectura imperial.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Estonia, un país báltico de ciudades medievales, bosques, costas tranquilas e innovación digital.
Artin sukia, se dedica a la fabricacion artesanal de abarcas y su hermana gloria, quien confecciona trajes tradicionales vascos. Gloria elabora una pastel de puerros y gambas.
Continuamos nuestra travesía por Brasil, para conocer los orígenes del cacao, hasta llegar a las costas de Río de Janeiro.
Polonia, Gdansk y Trojmiejski Ultra 65km
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Ciudad del Cabo, una ciudad sudafricana entre montañas, océano, viñedos y diversidad cultural.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a La Habana, una ciudad cubana de música, colores, autos clásicos e historia caribeña.
En el episodio de hoy viajamos a Shanghái, una metrópoli china de rascacielos, barrios históricos, comercio y modernidad vibrante.
Una ciudad en la que conviven la alta tecnología y una cultura milenaria.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar helps a fearful family, which is still holding on to the pain of losing their first dog in a tragic accident, deal with their two-year-old Black Lab's similarly aggressive personality. And later, a young 10-year-old girl looks to Cesar for help when her emotional support puppy is causing more chaos than comfort.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar sets out to help a young couple's sensitive Australian cattle dog, whose severe separation anxiety has held hostage the lives of his pet parents for nearly a year. And later, Cesar attempts to calm a blinding Lhasa Apso, who lacks basic hygiene and has almost become too hostile for his exhausted owners to provide his needed eye care.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar rehabs an aggressive Rhodesian Ridgeback and anxious Mini Schnauzer.

Cesar and Andre Millan are in Los Angeles to visit with the heroes of the local canine community. They help a golden retriever who survived a horrific burning, and whose owners hope that he can become a therapy dog for other burn survivors.

Cesar Millan helps two owners with their ferocious bulldog mix who attacked a neighbor's dog, then he's challenged by a couple who desperately need help to save their pit bull/lab mix from being put down after attacking their neighbor.
Cesar Millan is called to train an aggressive bulldog who’s bitten a couple’s son three times and brought their marriage to the brink of divorce.

Laxminandan perdona a Saraswatichandra y Kabir. Al ver a Kumud sufrir mareos e inquietud, Saras, preocupada, la lleva al médico. Después de algunas pruebas, Guniyal le anuncia a la familia Desai que Kumud está embarazada.

Kumud se sorprende al ver los regalos de Danny. Ella les informa a todos que se trata de un caso de intoxicación alimentaria. Mientras tanto, Saras tiene que trasladarse a Mumbai durante seis meses por negocios, pero Kumud se niega a ir con él.

Sarswatichandra intenta impresionar a Kumud cantando una canción, pero ella todavía se muestra reacia. Intenta convencerla de que vaya con él. Pero ella se niega e incluso lo empuja fuera de la cama, diciendo que tiene que dormir sola.
En un intento por convencer a Kumud de que acompañe a Saraswatichandra a Mumbai, la familia Desai elabora un plan y comienza a ignorarla. Saras finge lavar ropa para que Kumud lo acompañe.

Kabir sigue firme en su decisión de no casarse y formar una familia. Mientras tanto, con Kumud todavía furioso, Saras se ve obligada a pasar la noche en el sofá. Por otro lado, Kabir provoca que Danny y Kusum peleen.
A Peio van a concederle una beca para ir un año a Estados Unidos, pero la desaparición de la tablet en la que tiene guardado todo su trabajo pondrá en peligro que pueda conseguirlo.

Crichton stumbles upon the planet of Acquara, an Earth-like paradise where no mechanical devices seem to function after landing.
Mental cleansing changes a Peacekeeper, who once tormented Rygel, into a servile being; with Ben Browder, Gigi Edgley and Tiriel Mora.
Crichton travels through a wormhole that greatly affects Earth, where the entire crew is subjected to intense testing and imprisonment.
Moya tries to starburst to prove to the crew that she still can; it goes slightly wrong though and she gets stuck in starburst, and splits into several different dimensions.
Peacekeeper commandos board the ship after a fuel leak and join the Moya's crew in battle against a deadly virus.
Crichton must infiltrate a Peacekeeper base to save Aeryn's life, but ends up facing torture in an alien electric chair and archenemy Crais.
The crew of the Moya tries to save Crichton from the hands of Crais and the Peacekeepers; with Gigi Edgley and Wayne Pygram.
Moya and her unsuspecting crew encounter a carnivorous alien.

With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before enacting a plan to save Moya and her baby, named Talyn.
Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them; their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.

D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive; during the ritual the Orican draws energy from who she thinks is D'Argo but is actually Moya; consequently Moya starts to age rapidly.
Chiana joins a group of nihilistic teenagers on a cemetery planet.
An alien boards Moya, deranging the crew.
Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot; after seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya.
A fortunetelling portrait acquired from a passing trader turns out to be the tool of an old enemy. With Ben Browder.
Crichton and the crew desperately search for food to nurse an ailing friend back to health, but they may have to sacrifice a friend to save one.
Zhaan, Chiana and Rygel come to grips with the apparent deaths of Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo.
After an enemy ship fires on Moya, crew members find that their personalities have been switched. With Ben Browder.
Contact with a mysterious light source creates three separate Crichtons from different rungs of the evolutionary ladder.
Moya and her crew land on a planet just in time to celebrate the coronation of a new royal couple, but there is a catch -- the princess has not found her prince.
A quick turn of events sees Crichton chosen as the unwilling groom-to-be in the upcoming royal wedding.
Someone removes Crichton's head from a statue; Aeryn examines her choices; Zhaan faces a Moya builder.
A crew member falls prey to a shape-shifting parasite and the rest of the crew must locate it before it is too late.
Crichton becomes a mental slave on a commerce planet and must trust his greatest enemy, Scorpius, to help him see the truth through the illusions.
The crew races to save Crichton after contact with a hyper stream of time speeds up his aging process.
Talyn destroys a Plokavian ship, leading to the capture of the crew.
Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.
An outrageous love triangle ignites dangerous sparks aboard a space station, where the crew find themselves trapped during a powerful interstellar storm.
Crichton learns the elusive technology that could allow him to return home to Earth, but while he is preoccupied with the consequences a crew member unsuspectingly nears death.
A crew member must volunteer to stay behind to guide the sabotaged ship, knowing that it will soon be atomized.
Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.
